Boeing shares beat industry on strong orders and defense backlog.

Boeing MQ-28 Ghost Bat drone cleared a key stealth test. - Boeing awarded $528.32M modification for performance-based support contract. - Boeing spokesperson addresses Lufthansa 787-9 Dreamliner incident. - Qantas weighs order for 20 Boeing or Airbus wide-body jets. - Boeing stock gains as Singapore Airlines, Qantas eye wide-body orders. - Boeing explores hiking 737 production close to Airbus's target. - Boeing boosts aircraft deliveries and production with strong demand.
